QuestInfo.name: Lesson, Interrupted
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Kizan and continue on to the next lesson.
QuestInfo.1: You were about to begin the power battle training, but Training Instructor Kiku appeared! What could this be about?
QuestInfo.2: He said that there's something urgent going on with the new knights, and he wants you to wait here. Really? That sounds boring...
